name: @stonedogcode/featuremap
description: The feature-map schema: what a repository declares about its own features and the code paths that implement them, validated so a coverage gate can refuse a malformed map as a different verdict from an uncovered file.
author: StoneDogCode L.L.C.
//exports: `.` is the library. `./schema` is the raw JSON Schema, exported as a file so a consumer in another language -- the gate may end up a composite action running anything -- can read it without a JavaScript import.
//files: src/ ships as TypeScript SOURCE, matching @stonedogcode/tests. __tests__ is excluded because those import jest globals and a consumer parsing src/** would drag them in.

scripts.//test: Jest runs as ESM, which needs the VM modules flag.
scripts.//test:integration: Validates the REAL maps in this fleet, not fixtures. That is the seam: a schema that only ever sees its own examples has not been shown to accept the corpus it was written for.
scripts.//validate: The CLI the gate will call. Exits 0 valid, 1 invalid, 2 unreadable -- three states, because 'could not open the file' is not 'the file is wrong'.
